about: Public audit reports, fetched into .cache/public-corpus/ by scripts/fetch-public-corpus.mjs and measured by scripts/measure-opinion-locator.ts. Only URLs and hashes are committed, never the files. Found and verified 2026-10-25: each file downloaded twice with matching SHA-256, at most 25 MB and 500 pages, with a text layer on the auditor's report pages. opinionStartsWith holds the first words of the opinion as a person read them, so a wrong passage of the right type is caught. reportsInFile counts the independent auditor's reports a PDF holds; a PDF with two is refused as MULTIPLE_OPINION_HEADINGS unless only one carries an opinion heading.
